brief_summary: Hero art for the Trends pillar piece on Mode Designs' vendor-attention tracker score: a wave up to 98 (W40), a six-week staircase down to a floor of 68 (W46, a post-group-buy lull), then a small uptick to 71 in the most recent week (W47) on news of an upcoming Encore refresh. A coral sparkline over a faint warm-grey keyboard side-profile silhouette, a dashed ceiling reference at the W40 high, a dashed floor reference at the W46 low, a haloed focal dot at the terminal uptick, and the family's warm-bronze theme dot in the upper-right margin.
source: plan/bearings.md section Article hero art, colorful keyboard SVGs (locked 2026-05-09), trends piece maps to sparkline silhouette; cf. apps/web/public/hero-art/hall-effect-score-dips-wooting-ship-slips.svg for the closest prior entry in this family (same coral + keyboard-silhouette-beneath-the-chart treatment)
template: directive: simple line drawing + single splash of color illustrative of subject; trends piece -> sparkline silhouette, paired with a secondary grounding keyboard motif per family convention
subject: An eight-point sparkline (tracker weeks 2026-W40 through W47) tracing scores 98, 95, 72, 72, 70, 69, 68, 71: a near-ceiling open, a sharp two-week fall, five more weeks drifting down to a floor, then a small final-point uptick. A coral wash sits under the floor-to-uptick region as the visual anchor, since that uptick is the news event the article covers. A dashed ceiling line marks the W40 high; a dashed floor line marks the W46 low; the terminal point is enlarged with a halo ring to mark the uptick without overstating its size relative to the thirty-point fall that preceded it. A low-opacity warm-grey keyboard side-profile silhouette (case body with a typing-angle wedge and a row of keycap deck gaps) sits beneath the chart, below the baseline, as a quiet grounding motif.
stroke_weight: 2px (3px on the sparkline polyline itself, matching the family's emphasis convention for the focal trajectory)
alt: A coral sparkline tracing eight weekly points from a high ceiling down a six-week staircase to a floor, then ticking upward on the final point, plotted over a faint warm-grey keyboard silhouette, with a small warm-bronze theme dot in the upper-right margin.
notes: x coordinates for the eight weekly points (150, 279, 407, 536, 664, 793, 921, 1050) reuse the exact grid from the hall-effect-score-dips-wooting-ship-slips.svg / hall-effect-rapid-trigger-plateau.svg sparkline sequence for visual continuity across the trends-pillar family. y coordinates are a stylized plot of the score array [98, 95, 72, 72, 70, 69, 68, 71] from the article body's own six-week run recap, not a pixel-literal linear scale, consistent with family convention for sparkline hero art. No rendered text anywhere in the file; the climb, staircase, floor, and uptick carry the subject without labels. All XML comments use single-hyphen text only (no double-hyphen runs) per the svg-validity.test.ts regression guard at apps/web/src/__tests__/svg-validity.test.ts; verified locally with a manual double-hyphen scan inside comment bodies, clean.
